defs.def: to lose blood, especially from a wound or an injury 流血；失血

ex.s: Internal and external bleeding may also occur at this point.
ex.t: 此时也可能出现内出血和外出血的情况。

ex.s: He took my harpoon too and all the rope, he thought, and now my fish bleeds again and there will be others.
ex.t: 他把我的鱼叉和所有的绳子也拿走了，他想，现在我的鱼又在流血了，而且还会引来别的鲨鱼。

ex.s: Learn to call emergency services heart attack drowning sprained ankle poisoning bad cut/bleeding Australia Canada China Japan Most European countries New Zealand South Korea the UK the US 1 Have you ever called 120?
ex.t: 学习致电急救服务心脏病发作溺水扭伤脚踝中毒伤口/出血澳大利亚加拿大中国日本大多数欧洲国家新西兰韩国英国美国1您曾经拨打过120吗？

ex.s: Then ask her to squeeze her nose just below the until the bleeding stops.
ex.t: 然后让她捏住鼻梁下方的鼻子，直到出血停止。

defs.def: to take blood from sb as a way of treating disease 旧时
to force sb to pay a lot of money over a period of time 长期榨取（某人的钱）
to remove air or liquid from sth so that it works correctly 放掉气体或水（以使某物运行正常）；抽干
to spread from one area of sth to another area 散开；渗开

chunks.cn: 流血 / 流血停止 / 流血发生
